say:1:1620958001:1.text: It began with a recipe. If you ask me, it was nothing special. But that is exactly what trends are all about—something that spreads for no reason at all.
say:1:1620958001:1.source_cn: 事情的开始，是一张花草茶的配方。要我说嘛，那配方也就普...

say:2:1620958002:1.text: No one knows who wrote it. It just went viral overnight. Soon the entire academy was innovating herbal tea recipes. Tea lovers, non–tea lovers—everyone wanted to brew the best.
say:2:1620958002:1.source_cn: 也不知道最初配方的作者是谁，总之它一夜间就火了。研发花...

say:3:1620958003:1.text: To outdo each other, they tested increasingly strange formulas... and some even resorted to odd magic.
say:3:1620958003:1.source_cn: 为了让自己的配方脱颖而出，他们开始实验各种各样稀奇古怪...

say:4:1620958004:1.text: Back then, the Lyceum didn't have a kind Hypogean like me keeping order. Tsk, tsk... those were some very entertaining days.
say:4:1620958004:1.source_cn: 那时的莱希拉姆可没有我这样好心的恶魔帮忙维系秩序。啧啧...

narration:6:1620958005:1.text: That was a long time ago. The student days before everything that came later.

say:8:1620958006:1.text: What is with these students? Alchemy class is not a tea salon! And yet here they are, brewing blends like the assignment doesn't exist!
say:8:1620958006:1.source_cn: 现在这群学生怎么回事，上炼金课不调配要求的药剂，天天拿...

say:9:1620958007:1.text: I let them practice freely once, and they handed in forty pots of herbal tea. Forty! What do they think this is, a tea house?
say:9:1620958007:1.source_cn: 上节课我让他们自由练习，结果整整收到了四十锅口味不同的...

say:10:1620958008:1.text: Tea in the crucibles? That's manageable. Look at me...
say:10:1620958008:1.source_cn: 他们只是在炼金坩埚里调配花草茶，这已经算很不错的了。看...

say:12:1620958010:1.text: Those maniacs—claimed they were researching mass production and illegally used the enlargement spell I taught them! In my class!
say:12:1620958010:1.source_cn: 那群疯狂的花草茶爱好者——他们号称是想要研究出“量产”...

say:13:1620958011:1.text: Dura above! I've never seen so much herbal tea... They flooded the classroom! Turned the building into an herbal tea lake!
say:13:1620958011:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我这辈子都没见过那么多花草茶……他们用花草茶...

say:14:1620958012:0.text: And my beard... my prized beard... soaked, destroyed!
say:14:1620958012:0.source_cn: 还有我的胡子……我精心保养的胡子，全被花草茶泡发了！全毁了！

say:16:1620958013:1.text: Oh, it still looks magnificent! In fact, it smells appetizing now.
say:16:1620958013:1.source_cn: 哦，我相信它现在仍然是非常好的胡子！瞧，它们现在闻起来...

say:17:1620958014:1.text: Leymar, I mean it. Another week of this and the students will turn the academy into a tea-fueled madhouse!

say:18:1620958015:1.text: Alright, alright, breathe. We replaced all the crucibles and issued a strict warning: herbal tea does not qualify as an alchemical potion.

say:19:1620958016:1.text: The flooded classroom is being cleaned. And Professor—about your beard becoming... excessively delicious—I offer my sincere condolences. I've already contacted a specialist to help you restore it.
say:19:1620958016:1.source_cn: 至于被花草茶淹没的教室，我们已经派人去打扫。以及，教授...

say:21:1620958017:1.text: Now then. Your problems are handled. Which leaves... dear Zorya. Were you also attacked by herbal tea? Anything I can do?
say:21:1620958017:1.source_cn: 两位的问题已经解决了，那么——亲爱的佐尔娅，你也遭遇了...

say:22:1620958018:1.text: No. To be precise, I stopped an explosion caused by rule-breaking herbal tea development.
say:22:1620958018:1.source_cn: 没有。准确来说，我今天又阻止了一起违规花草茶研发导致的...

say:23:1620958019:1.text: Only one? Looks like the situation is still—
say:23:1620958019:1.source_cn: 只有一起？看来同学们还是——

say:24:1620958020:1.text: It is eight in the morning. This month alone, I have prevented eighteen such cases.
say:24:1620958020:1.source_cn: 现在是早上八点。截至目前，本月我已经阻止了了十八起类似...

say:25:1620958021:1.text: Additionally, an Herbal Tea Competition is in full swing. Students are competing to brew the best.
say:25:1620958021:1.source_cn: 除此以外，学校开始流行名为“花草茶评比大赛”的竞争，学...
